profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
Java Developer with 10+ years of experience in software development with proficiency in all
aspects of the software lifecycle with experience defining software processes and procedures.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develops software components according to design specifications prepared by product management and following CreditRisk design patterns and standards. Responsible for unit testing deliverables and integrating with code stream from rest of development team. Performance tuning and optimization of execution in test environments. Refactoring and code maintenance between releases. Maintenance and bug-fixing for developed code.

positions.title: Software Engineering Group Leader
positions.description: I work on control systems software for drill floor tools. I am involved in all aspects of the software cycle from concept to design to testing to implementation to maintenance. I am also responsible for defining our software processes and procedures.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, setup and maintain control system software for drill floor tools.

positions.title: Next Generation Employee
positions.description:
Participated in a year long rotational program where I was assigned to different areas of the corporation in three month intervals. The groups that I was assigned were:

- Corporate Engineering Technology
- Software Control Systems
- Distribution Procurement
- Business Applications
